card: This PR updates the depends recipe for qrencode to fetch tag archives from GitHub instead of its original upstream website, which now returns 404. It saves the file under a new name, qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz, with an updated checksum. A previous attempt to change the URL without renaming the file had to be reverted in #33577 because the different hash broke fallback downloads for release branches.
evidence: PR description: 'https://fukuchi.org/works/qrencode/qrencode-4.1.1.tar.gz returns 404, so depends takes qrencode from the bitcoincore.org fallback.'

PR description citing #33577: '#33577 reverted it because the new hash under the old name broke the release branches. In #33577 theuni proposed to change the file name too, and achow101 agreed to do that in a follow-up.'
problem: The original upstream URL for `qrencode` returns 404, causing builds to rely solely on the bitcoincore.org fallback mirror. A previous switch to GitHub (#33494) changed the tarball hash under the original filename and was reverted in #33577 because it broke fallback downloads and cache verification on older release branches.

risk.why: A faulty dependency source URL or modified source archive could break depends builds or alter compiled dependencies across release binaries.

summary: Updates the `qrencode` depends recipe to download source archives from GitHub rather than the defunct upstream host. It renames the downloaded archive to `qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz` and updates the expected SHA256 checksum to prevent hash collisions on the fallback mirror.
